#!/usr/bin/env python3
import importlib.util, json, statistics, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/Users/0x1/Documents/htdocs/altbak.pub-gopurs')
work=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('diagnostic',root/'bin/benchmark/json-diagnostic.py')
diag=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(diag)
suite=sys.argv[1]
out=work/'measurements'/suite;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
builds={k:work/k/suite for k in ['before','after']}
manifests={k:json.loads((v/'manifest.json').read_text()) for k,v in builds.items()}
allowed={str(diag.COMPILER/'bin/gopurs-native')}
for k,m in manifests.items():
    assert m['suite']==suite
    assert m['binary_sha256']==diag.sha(builds[k]/'benchmark')
    assert m['js_sha256']==diag.sha(builds[k]/'benchmark.mjs')
assert {k:v for k,v in manifests['before']['sources'].items() if k not in allowed}=={k:v for k,v in manifests['after']['sources'].items() if k not in allowed}, 'Benchmark/library/toolchain input changed'
assert manifests['before']['generated_tast']==manifests['after']['generated_tast'], 'TAST changed'
assert manifests['after']['sources']==diag.fingerprint(suite)
corpus,info=diag.corpus_data(suite);(out/'corpus.json').write_bytes(corpus)
env=diag.environment();env['DIAG_CORPUS']=str(out/'corpus.json')
oracle=json.loads((diag.fixtures(suite)/'expected.json').read_text())
results={k:[] for k in ['before','after','js']}
order=['before','after','js','js','after','before','after','before','js']
for i,k in enumerate(order):
    cmd=['node',builds['after']/'benchmark.mjs'] if k=='js' else [builds[k]/'benchmark']
    log=out/f'{i}-{k}.json'
    diag.call(cmd,builds['after'],log,env)
    data=json.loads(log.read_text());diag.validate_result(data,oracle,suite)
    results[k].append(data)
    print(k,{p:round(v['time_us']/1000,3) for p,v in data['phases'].items()},flush=True)
assert manifests['after']['sources']==diag.fingerprint(suite)
phases=['parse','decode','combined']
medians={k:{p:statistics.median(r['phases'][p]['time_us'] for r in runs) for p in phases} for k,runs in results.items()}
allocated={k:{p:statistics.median(s['allocated_bytes'] for r in results[k] for s in r['phases'][p]['samples']) for p in phases} for k in ['before','after']}
report={'suite':suite,'protocol':{'processes_per_variant':3,'warmups_per_phase':2,'samples_per_phase':5,'cell':'median of process minimum times','GOMAXPROCS':1,'GOGC':100,'PGO':'off','file_io_timed':False,'fingerprinting_timed':False,'order':order},'corpus':info,'medians_us':medians,'allocated_bytes':allocated,'results':results,'builds':manifests,'binary_bytes':{k:(b/'benchmark').stat().st_size for k,b in builds.items()}}
(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');(out/'corpus.json').unlink()
print(json.dumps({'medians_us':medians,'allocated_bytes':allocated,'binary_bytes':report['binary_bytes']},indent=2))
